source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; remove all DIMMs, power on after BMC is ready, and check POST/SEL event 0xE310 with `No DIMM is populated`.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES only reads an assumed PostLog collection; it cannot create or prove the all-DIMM-absent stimulus, code meaning, physical/power safety or exact recovery and incorrectly claims no risk.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION restores no-DIMM stimulus, ESD/maintenance gates, bounded boot, causal event correlation and DIMM reinstall.

old_problem: A stale/read-only POST record was proposed as the test while the actual case requires removing every DIMM and powering an intentionally unbootable configuration. Module/slot identity, complete power isolation, platform-specific 0xE310 semantics, attempt boundary, no-POST timeout and exact hardware restoration were missing.
disposition_reason: The stimulus, expected code/description and acceptance are explicit. The review layer can safely parameterize exact platform authorization, code schema, DIMM map, service procedure and timeout while assigning all physical/power actions to qualified humans. One approved negative boot with complete bounded POST/SEL evidence is followed by exact serialized reinstall and full training/inventory/boot recovery; no AI or automation performs the DUT action.
decision_basis: XLSX row 868, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, selection manifest and historical record were directly reviewed.
Causality requires the verified all-sockets-empty state, one identified boot attempt and its new canonical 0xE310 event, not historical code presence.
The approved physical-hardware rule assigns DIMM handling to qualified people; the cycle rule requires an exact power transition and recovery rather than an ambiguous command.
ED-09 preserves manual hardware handling, ED-17 preserves logs, ED-18 requires full power-state evidence, ED-20 preserves all-DIMM and recovery coverage, and ED-38 forbids retry.

test_case.test_name: Verify one all-DIMM-absent boot produces platform event 0xE310 and restore the exact memory topology
test_case.purpose: Prove that one explicitly approved boot attempt with every DIMM physically absent produces the platform-defined POST/SEL `0xE310` record with the authoritative `No DIMM is populated` meaning, then restore every serialized module to its original slot and prove normal memory training, inventory, POST and OS operation.
required_package: Exact chassis/board/BMC/BIOS identities and vendor confirmation that one no-memory power-on is an approved diagnostic stimulus
Complete DIMM serial/part/capacity/rank/speed-to-socket/channel map, orientation/latch photos and original population rules
Service manual for orderly shutdown, AC/DC isolation, discharge interval, ESD, chassis access, removal/insertion order and air-baffle/torque requirements
Dedicated maintenance window, no workloads/users, stable power, BMC/SOL/serial/OOB access, approved maximum no-POST wait and emergency power-off owner
Firmware-matched authority for 0xE310 source/encoding/message/severity/sensor/generator/direction plus attempt-time correlation and allowed companion events
Post-restore training limit, slot/channel/capacity inventory, latch inspection, normal POST/boot/OS and fault-log acceptance
test_case.test_command: Automation performs read-only identity, workload, power, memory inventory and complete POST/SEL baseline collection only. A qualified ESD-trained operator records serial-to-slot topology, follows the vendor shutdown/AC-DC isolation/discharge procedure, removes every DIMM and verifies/photos all empty sockets. After a fresh exact-target approval and BMC readiness, the authorized operator performs one power-on. Observe power/SOL/serial, mark the attempt boundary, enforce the no-memory timeout and collect every new raw/decoded POST/SEL record. Correlate the version-matched 0xE310 record and exact no-DIMM meaning to that attempt; do not retry. The operator then powers off through the approved path, reinstalls each serialized DIMM in its original slot/orientation and restores chassis parts. Verify latches, full capacity/channel inventory, bounded memory training, normal POST/OS/BMC health and new fault logs. Never clear logs or let automation remove hardware or power-cycle the DUT.
test_case.expected_result: The verified empty-memory configuration receives exactly one approved power-on and reaches the documented no-memory stop state within the allowed interval. Complete new POST/SEL evidence contains the authoritative 0xE310 event with no-DIMM description, correct source/severity/time and causal attempt boundary plus only allowed companion events. After approved power-off and reinstall, every module returns to its recorded socket, full memory capacity/channels train correctly and the platform completes normal POST/OS boot without new unexplained faults.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires platform authorization, immutable DIMM map, power/ESD/operator evidence, one bounded boot, complete causal raw/decoded 0xE310 match, exact reinstall and successful inventory/training/normal boot recovery with engineer verdict. A historical entry, generic PostLog GET, code string without authoritative decode, or boot without physical empty-state proof cannot pass. Missing/wrong code or description, unexpected event sequence/power state, module mix-up, capacity/channel loss, training fault or failed recovery is FAIL/recovery-required. Missing platform/code/service inputs is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Never remove/insert DIMMs with host power present or before the vendor discharge interval; independently verify AC/DC state and follow ESD controls.
Never guess sockets or mix modules; record serial-to-slot/orientation before removal and stop on unlabeled hardware, latch/socket damage or uncertain population rules.
Do not clear SEL/POST/system logs; use stable sequence/time boundaries to retain prior memory-fault evidence and identify the one attempt.
Do not infer 0xE310 semantics from its number or a generic field; require the exact board/BIOS/BMC specification and decoder revision.
Power on once only after fresh approval and BMC readiness; enforce the stop-state timeout and never retry automatically on absent/unknown behavior.
After capture, perform approved power-off and exact reinstall; stop/escalate on missing capacity, ECC/training error, boot loop, persistent fault or hardware damage.
expected_evidence: SUT/board/BIOS/BMC identity, maintenance authority, prior workload/power state and complete DIMM serial/part/capacity/channel/socket map/photos
AC/DC isolation/discharge/ESD checklist, qualified operator record and verified all-sockets-empty state
BMC-ready time, fresh boot approval, single power/SOL/serial timeline and bounded no-memory stop-state/timeout
Complete pre/post-boundary POST/SEL metadata and raw records with authoritative 0xE310 decode, no-DIMM meaning, generator/severity/time and causality
Approved power-off, serialized reinstall/latch/socket/chassis restoration evidence
Post-restore capacity/channel inventory, training duration, normal POST/OS/BMC health, fault-log review, no-retry proof and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unexpected power, event or stop-state behavior, do not boot again. Preserve all evidence and have the authorized operator use the approved power-off path, reinstall the recorded modules exactly and verify latches/topology. Use BMC/OOB and the vendor recovery runbook for training/boot faults; escalate any hardware damage, capacity loss or persistent ECC event.
